light.label: Light
light.hint: Spotting, or a liner is enough

period.label: Period
period.insight: Hormones are at their lowest. Rest, iron-rich food, and gentle movement help most now.

follicular.label: Follicular
follicular.insight: Oestrogen is climbing. Energy and focus usually rise, so it is a good window for harder workouts.

ovulatory.label: Ovulatory
ovulatory.insight: Oestrogen peaks around ovulation. Highest chance of conception in these days.

luteal.label: Luteal
luteal.insight: Progesterone rises then falls. Bloating, mood shifts, and cravings are common before your period.

help.title: Tell us what's <1>wrong.</1>
help.messagePlaceholder: What happened? The more detail, the faster we can fix it.
help.emailReply: Reply to me by email instead of in the app
help.dpdpNotice: We use what you write here only to answer you. It is stored on Anuva Wellness systems, never emailed to anyone outside, and deleted after {{months}} months. You can ask us to delete it sooner, or withdraw this at any time, under the <1>DPDP Act</1>. Please don't include health details you wouldn't want our support team to read — for anything clinical, book a consultation instead.
help.submitted: Got it — your reference is {{reference}}. We usually reply within two working days, right here in the app.
help.empty: Nothing yet. Anything you send will show up here with our reply.
help.grievance: Unhappy with how we handled your data? Write to our Grievance Officer at <1>{{email}}</1>.

confirm.sendCodeFailed: Could not send the code. Please try again.

recordings.label: Delete call recordings
recordings.description: Every audio recording of your consultations, and the files behind them.
recordings.collateral: Your prescriptions, diet plans and the record that the consultation happened are kept. A doctor is required to hold those for three years.

chat.label: Delete chat with Anu
chat.description: Every message you and Anu exchanged.
chat.collateral: Anu starts fresh and will not remember earlier conversations. Answers Anu had cached from your wording are cleared too.

tracker.label: Delete tracked health history
tracker.description: Periods, mood, sleep, energy, hot flashes and every other daily entry you have logged.
tracker.collateral: Weekly reports and wellness scores built from those entries go with them, and cycle predictions restart from your next log.

account.label: Delete my account
account.description: Everything above, plus your profile, assessments, care plan and subscription.
account.collateral: Consultation records and prescriptions are kept for three years because a doctor is required to hold them, then deleted automatically. Your name, phone number and email are removed from them straight away.

privacy.title: Your data is yours
privacy.intro: Under the <1>Digital Personal Data Protection Act</1>, you can see what we hold, take a copy of it, and have it deleted. Everything below acts on your account right away — we do not need to be asked twice.
privacy.pendingTitle: Your account is scheduled for deletion
privacy.pendingBody: It will be deleted on {{date}}. Until then nothing has been removed, and you can stop it.
privacy.noSelling: We do not sell your data and there are no advertising trackers in this app. The full list of services that process it is included in your data download.
privacy.downloadBody: One file with everything above — useful if you want to show your own doctor what you have been tracking. Recordings and prescription files are not in it; download those from Your consultations.
privacy.exportBlocked: You can ask for another copy after {{date}}.
privacy.graceNote: Account deletion waits {{grace}} days so you can change your mind, and finishes within {{sla}} days of your request.
privacy.grievance: Write to our Grievance Officer at <1>{{email}}</1>. If we do not resolve it, you can escalate to the Data Protection Board of India.
privacy.askInApp: Ask us in the app instead
privacy.accountUndone: This cannot be undone once it runs. You have {{grace}} days to change your mind, and you will stay signed in until then.
privacy.exportConfirmBody: We will build one file containing everything Anuva holds about you and download it to this device.
privacy.exportConfirmNote: The link works once and expires in 24 hours. Keep the file somewhere safe — it is your full health history, and once it is on your device it is out of our hands.
privacy.cancelConfirmBody: Your account stays exactly as it is and nothing will be deleted. You can ask again at any time.
privacy.loadFailed: Could not load your data. Please try again.
privacy.nothingToDelete: There was nothing left to delete in that category.
privacy.downloaded: Your data has been downloaded. The link has now been used and cannot be reopened.
privacy.deletionCancelled: Your account will not be deleted. Nothing has been removed.
privacy.accountScheduled: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {{date}}. You can cancel any time before then.
